page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan: left page, a two-column page with a running head and Hebrew-letter head "כת", then a horizontal rule; below the rule two columns. Right page: a two-column page with a running head "לא" and the same structure. Page number "214" at top left. Columns of entries with Hebrew words in italics and Latin glosses. Marginal notes: none printed outside the columns.

main_text.head: כת
main_text.p: כְּתֻבוֺנָן secundum intelle-ctum suum, pro כְּתֻבוֹנָתָן Hof. 13. 2. No. f. f. תְּמוּנָה, præf. & aff. R. בן intellexit.
כְּתֹּנ contundite, Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. כָּתַת.
כָּתוּם contusum, Pahul Kal, f. m. & כְּתוּת contundere, Infin. Kal, Rad. כָּתַת.
כְּתוֹתֵי contudi, præt. Kal, 1. f. R. כָּתַת.
כְּתִית tusum, No. f. m. R. כָּתַת.
כְּתֻנְּךָ tunica ejus, tua, כְּתֻנְּתָם tunicæ eorum, inf. כְּתֻנָּה, R. כתן.
כָּתְּתוּ tutuderunt, præt. Piel, כִּתְּתוּ contusi sunt, præt. Pual, 3. pl. R. כָּתַת.
לאור ad illustrandum, Job. 33.3. pro לְהָאוֹר, Infin. Niph. Rad. אור.
לֹא non, Part. neg. interdum, pro לוֹ ipsi.
לְאַבְּרֵנִי ad perdendum me, Infin. Piel, præf. aff. Rad. אבר.
לְאַטֵּי leniter, לְאַטִּי ad lentitudinem meam, No. f. m. vel Part. אַט, præf. aff. Rad. אטט.
לְאָרִיב ad cruciandum, 1 Sam. 2. 33. pro לְהַאֲרִיב, Infin. Hiph. Rad. ארב: vel per transp. Lit. pro לְהַרְאִיב, Infin. Hiph. à Rad. רָאַב doluit.
לַאְמִים clam, senfim, pro בְּלָט, No. f. m. לט, præf. Rad. לוט abscondit.
לְאֹם natio, מְּאֹם pro natione, לְאֻמִּים nationes,

page.notes: Hebrew transcription is approximate: the scan is blurred, and many vowel points and letters in the Hebrew words could not be read with certainty. Latin glosses were read more confidently. Some words in the lower left column are partly obscured by a grey smudge and the text there is uncertain. Page number 214 is printed at top left. The rule separates the upper and lower halves of each page. The Hebrew head כת on the left and לא on the right are running heads. The final line of the lower right column ends with "nes," and continues beyond the page.
